1124 def _build_oob_url(finding_id: Any, oob_token: str = "") -> str | None:
1125     """Construct the OOB callback URL for a finding.
1126 
1127     V5 Sprint 8: Now uses the per-finding ``oob_token`` instead of the
1128     global ``Settings.oob_callback_secret``. This closes a spoofing
1129     vulnerability where a malicious target that observed one OOB URL
1130     could forge callbacks for *any* other finding by swapping the
1131     finding_id in the path — every finding now has its own unguessable
1132     32-char hex token.
1133 
1134     Returns ``None`` when OOB is disabled (the global secret is empty,
1135     meaning the operator never opted in) so the caller can fail closed to
1136     human review without any network round-trip.
1137 
1138     Args:
1139         finding_id: UUID of the finding (used in the URL path).
1140         oob_token: Per-finding random token. If empty (e.g. for a
1141             finding loaded from a pre-Sprint-8 DB without the column),
1142             the function returns ``None`` to fail safe — we never want
1143             to issue an OOB URL that uses the global secret as a
1144             fallback, since that would reintroduce the spoofing risk.
1145     """
1146     from webpent.config.settings import get_settings
1147 
1148     settings = get_settings()
1149     # V5 Sprint 14: oob_callback_base_url defaults to "" (empty).
1150     # When empty, OOB URL construction is disabled — SSRF/RCE findings
1151     # fail closed to Needs Human Review. The operator must explicitly set it
1152     # (e.g. http://localhost:8000 or http://api:8000 in Docker).
1153     if not settings.oob_callback_base_url:
1154         logger.info(
1155             "OOB validation skipped for finding %s: oob_callback_base_url "
1156             "is empty (feature disabled). Set WEBPENT_OOB_CALLBACK_BASE_URL "
1157             "to enable OOB-based SSRF/RCE confirmation.",
1158             finding_id,
1159         )
1160         return None
1161     # The global secret is now an on/off switch for the OOB feature,
1162     # not a credential used in the URL itself.
1163     if not settings.oob_callback_secret:
1164         logger.warning(
1165             "OOB validation skipped for finding %s: oob_callback_secret "
1166             "is empty (feature disabled).",
1167             finding_id,
1168         )
1169         return None
1170     if not oob_token:
1171         # Fail safe: no per-finding token means we cannot construct a
1172         # spoof-resistant URL. Fail closed to human review.
1173         logger.warning(
1174             "OOB validation skipped for finding %s: no per-finding "
1175             "oob_token available (pre-Sprint-8 finding?). Falling back.",
1176             finding_id,
1177         )
1178         return None
1179     base = settings.oob_callback_base_url.rstrip("/")
1180     return f"{base}/api/oob/{finding_id}/{oob_token}"
